text: Thank you for the update; with a normal ECG and no structural heart abnormalities, this strongly suggests situational syncope, specifically micturition syncope. Did you have a full bladder before entering the bathroom, and were you standing up quickly after finishing urination? speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Episode of loss of consciousness. I also have Regained consciousness quickly without confusion, No urinary incontinence, No bite marks or injuries.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Micturition Syncope. Given the classic timing after urination, rapid recovery without confusion, and normal cardiac workup, this is a reflex syncope caused by vasovagal mechanisms triggered by bladder emptying. I recommend avoiding standing immediately after voiding and ensuring the room is well-lit. Please seek immediate care if you experience chest pain, palpitations, or fainting unrelated to urination.
